judgment.status_reasoning: The stored PDF is the August 2024 draft, marked 'DRAFT' on every page; that much is quoted under status. The published status, Superseded, says the final strategy of September 2025 (NG-02) replaced it; the only stored file that shows this is NG-02's own PDF (archive/NG-02/2026-10-11/official.pdf, which records a public review of the first draft and engagement from July 2024 to January 2025), and storing that PDF for NG-01 failed in this run. Status is therefore left as published and not listed as confirmed, and the gap is an open question.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A draft national AI strategy with an AI ethics framework, a planned AI governance regulatory body and a national AI risk management framework; in scope, with a scope_note because its main focus is infrastructure, ecosystem and adoption.
judgment.date_reasoning: The cover reads 'DRAFT AUGUST, 2024'; no day is given, so 2024-08 is kept. date_last_updated (2025-09, the final strategy) is left as published and not confirmed, since its only evidence is the cover of NG-02's PDF.
judgment.topics_reasoning: Unchanged and supported: accountability & liability (AI Governance Regulatory Body to ensure compliance; accountability for AI decisions), evaluation & testing (AI ethics assessment framework; robust testing and validation), human oversight (human oversight and intervention among the risk-reduction tools). The summary is unchanged; its claims are on pages 23, 39-40 and 42.

open_questions: Status 'Superseded', date_last_updated 2025-09 and the notes ('superseded by the final NAIS of Sept 2025') rest only on the final strategy's PDF, stored for record NG-02 (archive/NG-02/2026-10-11/official.pdf, page 61: 'a public review of the first draft'; page 1: 'SEPTEMBER, 2025'). Storing that PDF for NG-01 failed on 18 Oct 2026 (connection to ncair.nitda.gov.ng timed out). Left as published; a later run that can store it for NG-01 can confirm them.

The notes' phrase 'released Aug 2024 for consultation' is not shown by NG-01's own file, which carries only the 'DRAFT' marking and the August 2024 date; the public review of the first draft is recorded in NG-02's PDF. Left as published.
